title: Lost Communication With ECM/PCM A
shortDescription: Lost Communication With ECM/PCM A: bus communication fault.
fullDescription: Lost Communication With ECM/PCM A — module is not responding on the data bus within the expected timeout.
safetyImpact: Lost communication between modules can disable safety systems and drivability features.

causes.cause: CAN/communication bus wiring open or shorted
Failed module on the bus
Loose or corroded connector at module
Low battery voltage causing module dropouts

symptoms: Multiple warning lamps illuminated
Modules not communicating with scan tool
Erratic gauge or display behavior
Vehicle may not start or enter limp mode

fixSteps.title: Scan for codes
fixSteps.instruction: Connect an OBD-II scan tool, record all codes and freeze frame, then attempt to clear and reproduce.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect related wiring, connectors, fuses, and components for visible damage, corrosion, or looseness.

fixSteps.title: Test circuit and component
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter or scan tool live data to verify sensor signals, supply voltage, and ground integrity against spec.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed part and verify
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the confirmed faulty component, clear the code, and road test under conditions that triggered the fault.

faq.q: Is it safe to drive with code U0100?

faq.q: Will U0100 clear itself?
faq.a: After the underlying fault is fixed, the code may self-clear after several drive cycles, or you can clear it with a scan tool.
